verdict.rationale: Kosmos is documented to produce "comprehensive cited report[s]" and "citable reports" with publication-ready figures and data visualizations alongside its written analysis. The core report-output capability is therefore first-party, and Literature adds synthesis output with diagram creation and figure pullouts. However, nothing documents the report's structure (sections, tables, executive summary) or any way to share or export it with stakeholders. missing for 10: documented report structure with sections/tables/summary, sharing or export functionality, independent or hands-on corroboration of report quality.
